title: Attending to Memory Writes Reduces Seed Variability in Recurrent Length Generalization
summary: Matched seed and gradient ablations characterize how bounded attention placement changes length extrapolation in the studied recurrent task. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
